scope: Isolate function coverage and line-map writes; canonical serial publication. Native function workers are not implemented in this slice.

implementation.linemap: One reusable emitter-private scratch; cache harvest before direct canonical encoding; clear rows after publication; reset enclosing source site at every body.
implementation.coverage: Private counter and owner log; validate range/capacity/all owners before publication. Coverage IDs still depend on serial order.
implementation.perceus: Mutable scratch is per instance. Future CPU workers must own separate Wasmtime Store/Instance/heap and run jobs serially inside each instance.
remaining: bounded function-job snapshot and product transport
independent coverage range planning; keep instrumented mode serial initially

measurement.protocol: N4 ABBA pairs, identical frozen corpus; isolated parsed-source cache per pair; checked/body/artifact caches off; native JIT primed; RC1 whole FS compile; RSS20ms; no concurrent work.

cpu_profiles.protocol: Three separate warm profiles per subject and variant, after one cold priming run. Guest CPU sample percentages are inclusive, not full-build wall shares.

interpretation: No speedup claim. All timing ranges overlap; medians change -0.63% to +1.29%. Median RSS changes -0.14 to -0.41 MiB. CLI output is byte-identical; compiler output differs only in vibe.linemap, reduced by 30,284 bytes after removing inherited enclosing source sites. All executable and other section bytes match.

validation.targeted: 64 tests in 10 files passed through the rebuilt candidate; plus 32 instrumented fixture tests.
validation.regression: Old library fails the non-vacuous whole-vs-slice line-map test; candidate passes in both RC modes.
validation.outputs: 32 timed and 16 profiling/priming builds are stable by subject and variant; only the expected compiler line-map section differs across variants. Two coverage outputs are byte-identical and both execute.

limitations: Single WSL machine, frozen baseline corpus including regenerated bundles; no native multi-worker timings yet.
RSS sampled every20ms; this is resident high water, not allocation volume.
Source-site isolation intentionally changes compiler debug metadata; do not claim whole-Wasm equality for that corpus.
Coverage counter isolation does not assign independent ranges; coverage-enabled fan-out remains unsupported.

import os,subprocess,json,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
lab=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;corpus=lab/'corpus';key=sys.argv[1];image=lab/key
clean={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('VIBE_')}
clean.update(VIBE_LIB=str(corpus/'lib'),VIBE_PREOPEN_DIR=str(corpus),VIBE_RC='1',VIBE_FS_COMPILE='1',VIBE_IMPORT_ABI='raw',VIBE_CHECKED_MODULE_CACHE='off',VIBE_CODEGEN_BODY_CACHE='off',VIBE_DISABLE_PERSISTENT_ARTIFACT_CACHE='1',VIBE_NATIVE_CACHE_DIR=str(lab/'native-cache'))
for subject,source,entry in [('compiler','lib/@vibe/compiler/tests/codegen_lexer_test.vibe','__no_entry__'),('cli','lib/@vibe/cli/entry.vibe','cli_main')]:
 out=lab/f'profile-{key}-{subject}';out.mkdir()
 env=clean|dict(VIBE_BUILD_CACHE_DIR=str(out/'cache'))
 hashes=[]
 for n in range(4):
  e=env.copy()
  if n:e['VIBE_GUEST_PROFILE']=str(out/f'{n}.json')
  dest=out/f'{n}.wasm'
  with (out/f'{n}.log').open('w') as log:
   subprocess.run([str(image/'viberun'),str(image/'compiler.wasm'),source,str(dest),entry],cwd=corpus,env=e,stdout=log,stderr=log,check=True,timeout=300)
  hashes.append(hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
  print(key,subject,n,'warm profile' if n else 'cold priming',flush=True)
 assert len(set(hashes))==1
